Set tiers

A user can hold several at once; click to toggle. Applying replaces everything they hold; none selected = no access.

Replay pending add-on grants
Applies add-on grants parked for accounts that have since signed in. Parked tier grants don’t replay, so re-apply them above once the person signs in.

Tiers: admin · client · lifetime · subscriber. Grants take effect the next time the app checks access. Also see Invoice a client · Ops console.
